content: The pass is closed until day 5 (today is day 1). Pushing the rocks is wasted time. Best plan: read the notice board (confirms schedule), then spend the days productively farming the meadow soil, and be ready at the pass on day 5.

args.approach: Rockslide Pass (11,4) is the only route north and is impassable until day 5; today is day 1. So: read the notice board to confirm, then till/plant/water parsnips in the meadow to pass the days, and wait near the pass until day 5, then walk up the east corridor to the chest at (11,1).
